const stages = ["📤seed", "🌱seedling", "🪴sapling", "🌲evergreen", "🍓fruit"];
const current = tp.frontmatter.maturity || "📤seed";
const choice = await tp.system.suggester(stages, stages, false, `Current: ${current}`);

if (choice) {
  await tp.file.writeYaml("maturity", choice);
  new Notice(`🌱 Set to: ${choice}`);
  tR = `✅ Maturity changed: ${current} → ${choice}`;
} else {
  tR = "❌ Action cancelled.";
}
%>

<%*
const file = tp.file.find_tfile(tp.file.title);
const cache = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file);
const fm = cache?.frontmatter || {};
let current = fm.status || "📥inbox";

// 🔁 Cycle forward
const cycle = ["📥inbox", "🔄active", "⏳waiting", "✅completed", "📦archived"];
let nextStatus = cycle[(cycle.indexOf(current) + 1) % cycle.length];

// 🧩 Read file content
let content = await app.vault.read(file);

// 🧩 Update status
if (content.includes("status:")) {
  content = content.replace(/status:.*/, `status: ${nextStatus}`);
} else {
  content = content.replace(/---/, `---\nstatus: ${nextStatus}`);
}

// 🧩 If archiving, add metadata
if (nextStatus === "📦archived" && !content.includes("archived_date:")) {
  const today = window.moment().format("YYYY-MM-DD");
  content = content.replace(/---/, `---\narchived_date: ${today}\narchive_reason: Auto-archived`);
}

// 🧩 Save file
await app.vault.modify(file, content);

// 🧩 Show notification
new Notice(`✅ Status updated: ${current} → ${nextStatus}`, 4000);
%>

<%*
const file = tp.file.find_tfile(tp.file.title);
const cache = app.metadataCache.getFileCache(file);
const fm = cache?.frontmatter || {};
let current = fm.status || "📥inbox";

// 🔁 Cycle backward
const cycle = ["📥inbox", "🔄active", "⏳waiting", "✅completed", "📦archived"];
let prevIndex = cycle.indexOf(current) - 1;
if (prevIndex < 0) prevIndex = cycle.length - 1;
let prevStatus = cycle[prevIndex];

// 🧩 Read file content
let content = await app.vault.read(file);

// 🧩 Update status
if (content.includes("status:")) {
  content = content.replace(/status:.*/, `status: ${prevStatus}`);
} else {
  content = content.replace(/---/, `---\nstatus: ${prevStatus}`);
}

// 🧩 Save changes
await app.vault.modify(file, content);

// 🧩 Show notification
new Notice(`↩️ Status reverted: ${current} → ${prevStatus}`, 4000);
%>
